reason: Genuine implementation error found during final scoring: concurrent workers for one seed could write and read the same final-release NPZ file. Three seed-2 Mode B units (A0, J, spectral_M025) aborted with an invalid-probability error that does not reproduce on the verified release file. Fix: atomic release writes, and final releases built once in the parent before workers start. The lock verifier now accepts this amendment for these two code files only.
unchanged: All fitted objects, 2017 fitting/validation releases, selections, protocol, comparisons, report code and data keep their original locked hashes. No representation, hyperparameter, threshold, contrast or selection changed.
corrected_replay: Every stored final prediction of every completed unit is replayed from the verified final releases (PREDICTION_REPLAY.json). Only units without completion records, plus any unit with a mismatch, are rescored. Original partial outputs are preserved under superseded_race_20260917/.
